title: Decomposing SGD Dynamics in Neural Networks: Teacher-Induced Spikes and Variance Inflation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study two-layer neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on a multi-index teacher model, focusing on how first-layer parameters orthogonal to the teacher subspace affect generalization. We decompose the first-layer weights into a signal component aligned with the teacher and an orthogonal complement, and analyze their joint SGD dynamics together with the second layer in the proportional limit. We show that although SGD updates to the complement are initially isotropic, the training dynamics induce teacher-dependent spectral spikes in the complement Gram matrix. This emergent anisotropy provides a concrete mechanism by which representation variance is amplified, and generalization degrades. To isolate this effect, we introduce Decomposed Dynamics, an analytically tractable surrogate whose asymptotic test-error dynamics coincide with those of SGD. translated_title: 分解神经网络中的SGD动力学：教师诱导的尖峰与方差膨胀
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在多指数教师模型上通过随机梯度下降（SGD）训练的两层神经网络，重点关注与教师子空间正交的第一层参数如何影响泛化性能。我们将第一层权重分解为与教师对齐的信号分量和正交补空间分量，并在比例极限下分析它们与第二层的联合SGD动力学。我们证明，尽管SGD对正交补空间的更新最初是各向同性的，但训练动力学会在补空间的Gram矩阵中诱导出依赖教师的谱尖峰。这种涌现的各向异性提供了一种具体机制，通过该机制表示方差被放大，泛化性能随之退化。为了隔离这一效应，我们引入了“分解动力学”，这是一个解析上可处理的替代模型，其渐近测试误差动力学与SGD完全一致。在使用ReLU学生网络的模拟中，冻结正交补空间的相关方向……
tldr: 该论文通过将第一层权重分解为信号分量与正交补空间，揭示了SGD训练会在正交补空间的Gram矩阵中诱导出依赖教师的谱尖峰，从而放大表示方差并导致泛化性能退化的具体机制。
en_tdlr: This paper decomposes first-layer weights into signal and orthogonal complement components, revealing that SGD training induces teacher-dependent spectral spikes in the complement Gram matrix, providing a concrete mechanism by which representation variance is amplified and generalization degrades.
